title: Flash SegaSaturn: Ochikazuki-hen
native_title: フラッシュ・セガサターン ～おちかづき編～
overview:
Flash Sega Saturn: Ochikadzuki-hen (フラッシュセガサターン おちかづき編) is a Japanese Sega Saturn demo disc. Unlike other Flash Sega Saturn series, this disc was bundled with the Saturn hardware.

Playable Demos included:
• Saturn Bomberman

Videos included:
• Cyber Troopers Virtual-On
• Sakura Taisen
• Tengai Makyou: Daiyon no Mokushiroku
